OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: preFIRMConstructionIndicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Pre-FIRM Subsidy Eligible
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description:
NOTE: The field name is incorrectly named and will be changed in a future version.
An indicator of whether or not the property is eligible for a pre-FIRM subsidy. Yes, is indicated with either a 'true' or '1'. No is indicated with either a 'false' or '0'.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: agricultureStructureIndicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Agriculture Structure Indicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Indicates whether a building is reported as being an agricultural structure in the policy application. Yes is indicated with either a 'true' or '1'. No is indicated with either a 'false' or '0'

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: asOfDate
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: As of Date
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: The effective date of the data in the file. In other words, the date when the record was created or last updated in the source system. When time is not specified in the field, it will default to T00:00:00.000Z

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: baseFloodElevation
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Base Flood Elevation
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Base Flood Elevation (BFE) is the elevation in feet from the Elevation Certificate at which there is a 1% chance per year of flooding

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: basementEnclosureCrawlspaceType
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Basement Enclosure Crawlspace Type

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: cancellationDateOfFloodPolicy
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Cancellation Date of Flood Policy
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: The cancellation date of the flood policy (if any); date the flood policy goes out of force.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: condominiumCoverageTypeCode
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Condominium Coverage Type Code

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: construction
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Construction Indicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Indicates whether this building is under construction. Yes is indicated with either a 'true' or '1'. No is indicated with either a 'false' or '0'

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: crsClassCode
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: CRS Classification Code

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: buildingDeductibleCode
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Building Deductible Code

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: contentsDeductibleCode
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Contents Deductible Code

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: elevatedBuildingIndicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Elevated Building Indicator

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: elevationCertificateIndicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Elevation Certificate Indicator

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: federalPolicyFee
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Federal Policy Fee
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Dollar amount of the Federal Policy Fee of the policy

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: ratedFloodZone
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Rated Flood Zone

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: hfiaaSurcharge
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: HFIAA Surcharge
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Required for all new and renewal policies on or after April 1, 2015. Congressionally mandated annual surcharge in dollars required by the Homeowner Flood Insurance Affordability Act of 2014 (HFIAA)

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: houseOfWorshipIndicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: House of Worship Indicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Indicates whether a building is reported as being a house of worship in the policy application. Yes is indicated with either a 'true' or '1'. No is indicated with either a 'false' or '0'.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: locationOfContents
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Location of Contents

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: lowestAdjacentGrade
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Lowest Adjacent Grade
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Lowest natural grade adjacent to the insured structure prior to excavating or filling. The difference in feet of the lowest natural grade adjacent to the building from the reference level of the building

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: lowestFloorElevation
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Lowest Floor Elevation
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: A building's lowest floor is the floor or level (including basement/enclosure/crawlspace/subgrade crawlspace) that is used as the point of reference when rating a building.  This includes the level to which a building is floodproofed*. The elevation in feet of the reference level of the building from the elevation certificate

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: nonProfitIndicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Non-Profit Indicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Indicates whether a building is reported as being a non-profit in the policy application. Yes is indicated with either a 'true' or '1'. No is indicated with either a 'false' or '0'

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: numberOfFloorsInInsuredBuilding
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Number of Floors in Insured Building

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: occupancyType
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Occupancy Type
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Code indicating the use and occupancy type of the insured structure. Note, 2-digit codes are for Risk Rating 2.0 policies.  1 = Single family residence; 2 = 2 to 4 Unit residential building; 3 = Residential building with more than 4 units; 4 = Non-residential building; 6 = Non-Residential Business; 11 = Single-family residential building with the exception of a mobile home or a single residential unit within a multi unit building; 12 = A residential non-condo building with 2, 3, or 4  units seeking insurance on all units; 13 = A residential non-condo building with 5 or more units seeking insurance on all units; 14 = Residential mobile/manufactured home; 15 = Residential condo association seeking coverage on a building with one or more units; 16 = Single residential unit within a multi-unit building; 17 = Non-residential mobile/manufactured home; 18 = A non-residential building; 19 = A non-residential unit within a multi-unit building;

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: originalConstructionDate
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Original Construction Date
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: The original date of the construction of the building.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: originalNBDate
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Original NB Date
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: The original date of the flood policy.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: policyCost
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Policy Cost
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Calculated in dollars by adding together calculated premium, reserve fund assessment, federal policy fee, and HFIAA surcharge

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: policyCount
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Policy Count
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Insured units in an active status. A policy contract ceases to be in an active status as of the cancellation date or the expiration date. Residential Condominium Building Association Policy (RCBAP) contracts are stored as a single policy contract but insure multiple units and therefore represent multiple policies

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: policyEffectiveDate
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Policy Effective Date
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: The effective date of the flood policy. When time is not specified in the field, it will default to T00:00:00.000Z. Effective March 1, 1995, the standard waiting period for new business applications and for endorsements increasing coverage is 30 days from the date of application and the presentment of premium.  (Example:  A policy applied for on April 3 would become effective at 12:01 a.m. on May 3.)

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: policyTerminationDate
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Policy Termination Date
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Date upon which the cancellation of a flood insurance policy becomes effective - either because it was cancelled or lapsed. When time is not specified in the field, it will default to T00:00:00.000Z

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: policyTermIndicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Policy Term Indicator

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: postFIRMConstructionIndicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Post-Firm Construction Indicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Indicates whether construction was started before or after publication of the FIRM. Yes is indicated with either a 'true' or '1'. No is indicated with either a 'false' or '0'. For insurance rating purposes, buildings for which the start of construction or substantial improvement was after December 31, 1974, or on or after the effective date of the initial FIRM for the community, whichever is later, are considered Post-FIRM construction

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: primaryResidenceIndicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Primary Residence Indicator

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: rateMethod
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Rate Method
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Indicates policy rating method: 1 - Manual; 2 - Specific; 3 - Alternative; 4 - V-Zone Risk Factor Rating Form; 5 - Underinsured Condominium Master Policy; 6 - Provisional; 7 - Preferred Risk Policy (PRPs issued for eligible properties located within a non-Special Flood Hazard Area [non-SFHA]); 8 - Tentative; 9 - MPPP Policy; A - Optional Post-1981 V Zone; B - Pre-FIRM policies with elevation rating - Flood Insurance Manual rate tables; E - FEMA Pre-FIRM Special Rates; F - Leased Federal Property; G - Group Flood Insurance Policy (GFIP); I - Incomplete Data Provisional - Risk Rated policy renewals to be Provisional rated when select fields are unknown at time of renewal; P - Preferred Risk Policy (A PRP renewal issued in the first year following a map revision for an eligible property that was newly mapped into the SFHA by the map revision, or new business written for an eligible property that was newly mapped into the SFHA by a map revision effective on or after October 1, 2008 - PRP Eligibility Extension); Q - Preferred Risk Policy (subsequent PRP renewals where the previous policy year was reported as a 'P' or 'Q'); R - Newly Mapped into SFHA; S - FEMA Special Rates; T - Severe Repetitive Loss Properties (formerly Target Group Full Risk). Effective October 1, 2013, code will no longer be valid; W - Pre-FIRM policies with elevation rating - Submit-for-Rate procedures; RatingEngine : Risk Rated policies where FEMA calculates the rates based on various risk factors.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: regularEmergencyProgramIndicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Regular Emergency Program Indicator

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: smallBusinessIndicatorBuilding
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Small Business Building Indicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Indicates whether the insured represents a small business. Yes is indicated with either a 'true' or '1'. No is indicated with either a 'false' or '0'. Small business is defined as a business with fewer than 100 employees in the policy application

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: totalBuildingInsuranceCoverage
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Total Building Insurance Coverage
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Total Insurance Amount in whole dollars on the Building

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: totalContentsInsuranceCoverage
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Total Contents Insurance Coverage
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Total Insurance Amount in whole dollars on the Contents

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: totalInsurancePremiumOfThePolicy
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Total Insurance Premium of the Policy
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Total Insurance Premium of the Policy in whole dollars. Negative values indicate a refund.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: cancellationVoidanceReasonCode
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Cancellation/Voidance Reason Code

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: subsidizedRateType
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Subsidized Rate Type

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: iccPremium
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Increased Cost of Compliance (ICC) Premium
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: The whole dollar amount of the Increased Cost of Compliance (ICC) premium selected before any discounts are applied by the company to rate the policy.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: reserveFundAssessment
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Reserve Fund Assessment
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: The dollar sum of the reserve fund as reported by the company

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: communityProbationSurcharge
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Community Probation Surcharge
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description:
The probation surcharge amount, in whole dollars, is calculated by the company to rate the policy.
NOTE: A probation surcharge is a flat surcharge that the policyholder must pay on each new or renewed policy issued covering property in a community that the NFIP has placed on probation under the provisions of 44 CFR 59.24

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: premiumPaymentIndicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Premium Payment Indicator

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: buildingReplacementCost
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Building Replacement Cost
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description:
Estimated cost in whole dollars to replace the building as reported by the insurer. 
NOTE: Replacement cost is not market value, and it does not include the cost of the land or contents. It is strictly the estimated cost to reconstruct the building

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: basicBuildingRate
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Basic Building Rate
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Basic building rate selected by the company. This data element must be reported for all policies with exception of Preferred Risk Policy (PRP)

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: additionalBuildingRate
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Additional Building Rate
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Additional building rate selected by the company. This data element must be reported for all policies except the Preferred Risk Policy (PRP)

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: basicContentsRate
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Basic Contents Rate
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Basic contents rate selected by the company. This data element must be reported for all policies with exception of Preferred Risk Policy (PRP)

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: additionalContentsRate
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Additional Contents Rate
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Additional contents rate selected by the company. This data element must be reported for all policies except the Preferred Risk Policy (PRP)

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: enclosureTypeCode
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Enclosure Type Code

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: buildingDescriptionCode
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Building Description Code

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: insuranceToValueCode
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Insurance to Value Code

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: postFirmVzoneIndicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Post-FIRM V Zone Indicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: This indicates, for 1981 Post-FIRM Zone V rating, whether certification has been provided in accordance with Section 60.3(e) (4) of the Federal floodplain management regulations. Yes is indicated with either a 'true' or '1'. No is indicated with either a 'false' or '0'.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: floodproofedIndicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Floodproofed Indicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description:
Indicates if the insured structure is floodproofed. Yes is indicated with either a 'true' or '1'. No is indicated with either a 'false' or '0'.
NOTE: Floodproofing is any combination of structural and non-structural additions, changes, or adjustments to structures which reduce or eliminate flood damage to a property. Floodproofing may be an alternative to elevating a building to or above the BFE; however, the NFIP requires a Floodproofing Certificate prior to considering floodproofing mitigation measures in rating a structure

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: waitingPeriodType
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Waiting Period Type

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: rolloverTransferCode
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Rollover/Transfer Code

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: endorsementEffectiveDate
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Endorsement Effective Date
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Date that a policy endorsement goes into effect.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: propertyPurchaseDate
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Property Purchase Date
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Indicates the date that the insured property was purchased.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: rentalPropertyIndicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Rental Property Indicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description:
Indicates if the property is a rental property. Yes is indicated with either a 'true' or '1'. No is indicated with either a 'false' or '0'.
NOTE: A rental property is a property from which the owner receives payment from the occupant(s), known as tenants, in return for occupying or using the property. Rental properties may be either residential or commercial.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: tenantIndicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Tenant Indicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Policy Holder is a tenant and not the owner of the property. Yes is indicated with either a 'true' or '1'. No is indicated with either a 'false' or '0'

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: stateOwnedIndicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: State-Owned Indicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description:
Indicates whether insured property is state owned. Yes is indicated with either a 'true' or '1'. No is indicated with either a 'false' or '0'.
NOTE: State owned property is land or other assets that are legally owned by  the state.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: disasterAssistanceCoverageRequiredCode
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Disaster Assistance Coverage Required Code

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: mandatoryPurchaseFlag
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Mandatory Purchase Flag
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Indicates if the policy is required by the mortgage lender. Yes is indicated with either a 'true' or '1'. No is indicated with either a 'false' or '0'

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: grandfatheringTypeCode
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Grandfathering Type Code

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: programTypeIndicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Program Type Indicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description:
Indicates if a property is qualified for emergency program coverage (true) or regular coverage (false). Yes is indicated with either a 'true' or '1'. No is indicated with either a 'false' or '0'.
NOTE: The initial phase of a communitys participation in the NFIP, as prescribed by Section 1306 of the National Flood Insurance Act of 1968 (NFIA) (42 U.S.C. 4056). In this phase, limited amounts of coverage are available.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: mapPanelNumber
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Map Panel Number
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Either the current map panel number for the property or the map panel number being used for rating, depending on MapInfo Type.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: mapPanelSuffix
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Map Panel Suffix
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Either the current map panel suffix for the property or the map panel suffix used for rating, depending on MapInfo Type.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: floodZoneCurrent
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Current Flood Zone

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: femaRegion
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: FEMA Region
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: FEMA Region

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: propertyState
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Property State
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: The two-character alpha abbreviation of the state in which the insured property is located

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: reportedZipCode
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Reported Zip Code
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: 5-digit Postal  Zip Code for the insured property reported by WYO partners

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: censusGeoid
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Census Block Group FIPS
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Numeric code that uniquely identifies all administrative/legal and statistical geographic areas for which the Census Bureau tabulates data. In this instance, the Census GeoID is presented at the Census Block Group level. This is an address-based 12-character code that is the concatenation of fields consisting of the 2-character state FIPS code, the 3-character county FIPS code, the 6-character census tract code, and the 1-character block group code. Block numbers beginning with a zero are associated with water-only areas. Please see: https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/geography/guidance/geo-identifiers.html

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: latitude
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Latitude
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Approximate latitude of the insured building (to 1 decimal place). This represents the approximate location of the insured property. The precision has been lessened to ensure individual privacy. This may result in a point location that exists in an incorrect county or state. Use the state and county fields for record aggregation for these dimensions

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: longitude
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Longitude
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Approximate longitude of the insured building (to 1 decimal place). This represents the approximate location of the insured property. The precision has been lessened to ensure individual privacy. This may result in a point location that exists in an incorrect county or state. Use the state and county fields for record aggregation for these dimensions

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: buildingOnFederalLand
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Building on Federal Land Indicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: An indicator of whether or not a building meets the NFIP definition of being located on federal land. Yes, is indicated with either a 'true' or '1'. No is indicated with either a 'false' or '0'

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: buildingPurpose
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Building Purpose
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Indicates if the building is residential, non-residential or mixed use.  (value : description): R : Residential (100%) N : Non-Residential (100%) M : Mixed Use

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: seasonallyOccupied
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Seasonally Occupied Indicator
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: An indicator of whether or not a building meets the NFIP definition of being seasonally occupied. Yes, is indicated with either a 'true' or '1'. No is indicated with either a 'false' or '0'

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: fullRiskPremium
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Full Risk Premium
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: The chargeable premium for a property based on its determined flood risk and the full cost to pay anticipated losses and expenses for that property.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: buildingOverWaterType
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Building Over Water Type
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Indicates if the insured building is not over water, partially over water, or fully/entirely over water. 1 : Not over Water 2 : Partially over Water 3 : Fully/Entirely over Water

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: foundationType
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Foundation Type
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description:
Type of foundation of the building or structure.
1 - Slab
2 - Basement 
3 - CrawlSpace 
4 - Elevated Without Enclosure Post Pile or Pier 
5 - Elevated With Enclosure Post Pile or Pier 
6 - Elevated With Enclosure Not Post Pile or Pier

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: id
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: ID
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Unique ID assigned to the record

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: obstructionType
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Obstruction Type
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description:
Code that describes the type of obstruction that may be present under an elevated building. An obstruction includes an enclosed area and/or machinery and equipment attached to the building below the lowest elevated floor.
10 : Free of obstruction
15 : With obstruction: enclosure/crawlspace with proper openings not used for rating (not applicable in V Zones)
20 : With obstruction: less than 300 sq. ft. with breakaway walls, but no machinery or equipment attached to building below lowest elevated floor, or the elevation of the machinery or equipment is at or above the Base Flood Elevation
24 : With obstruction: less than 300 sq. ft. with breakaway walls or finished enclosure and with machinery or equipment attached to building below lowest elevated floor. The elevation of the machinery or equipment is below the Base Flood Elevation.
30 : With obstruction: 300 sq. ft. or more with breakaway walls, but no machinery or equipment attached to building below the Base Flood Elevation
34 : With obstruction: 300 sq. ft. or more with breakaway walls or finished enclosure and with machinery or equipment attached to building below the Base Flood Elevation
40 : With obstruction: no walls, but the elevation of machinery or equipment attached to building is below Base Flood Elevation
50 : With obstruction: non-breakaway walls/crawlspace or finished enclosure with no machinery or equipment attached to building below lowest elevated floor
54 : With obstruction: non-breakaway walls/crawlspace or finished enclosure with machinery or equipment attached to building below lowest elevated floor
60 : With obstruction
70 : With Certification subgrade crawlspace (AE, A01-A30, unnumbered A, AO, AH,AOB, AHB zones)
80 : Without Certification subgrade crawlspace (all zones)
90 : With Enclosure: Elevated buildings with elevator below the BFE in A zones. No other enclosure below the BFE.
91 : Free of Obstruction: Elevated buildings with lattice, slats, or shutters (including louvers) enclosing the elevator below the BFE in V zones. No other obstruction or machinery and equipment (M&E) servicing the building located below the BFE. The building will be rated free of obstruction with the V zone elevator loading added to the building basic limit.
92 : With Enclosure: Elevated buildings with elevator below the BFE in A zones. Enclosure below the BFE has no proper openings, is finished, or is used for other than parking, building access,or storage.
94 : With Obstruction: Elevated buildings with elevator below the BFE in V zones. No other obstruction or machinery and equipment (M&E)servicing the building located belowthe BFE.
95 : With Obstruction: Elevated buildings with elevator below the BFE in V zones. Breakaway wall obstruction is unfinished and elevator and obstruction are located below the BFE but no machinery and equipment (M&E) servicing the building is located below the BFE.
96 : With Obstruction: Elevated buildings with elevator below the BFE in V zones. Breakaway wall obstruction is finished or is used for other than parking, building access, or storage.
97 : With Obstruction: Elevated buildings with elevator below the BFE in V zones. No other obstruction, but has M&E servicing the building located below the BFE.
98 : With Obstruction: Elevated buildings with elevator below the BFE in V zones. Breakaway walls obstruction and M&E servicing the building are located below the BFE.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: nfipRatedCommunityNumber
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Rated NFIP Community ID Number
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: A six-digit designation identifying the rated NFIP community. The first two numbers are the state code. The next four are the FEMA-assigned community number. An alphabetical suffix is added to a community number to identify revisions in the FIRM for that community

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: nfipCommunityNumberCurrent
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Current NFIP Community Number
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: A six-digit designation identifying the current NFIP community. The first two numbers are the state code. The next four are the FEMA-assigned community number. An alphabetical suffix is added to a community number to identify revisions in the FIRM for that community

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: nfipCommunityName
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Rated NFIP Community Name
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: A local political entity that has the authority to adopt and enforce floodplain ordinances for the area under its jurisdiction.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: reportedCity
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Reported City
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: City where the insured building is located. A value of "NA" indicates the city value is currently unavailable.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: elevationDifference
OpenFemaDataSetFields.title: Elevation Difference
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description:
Difference between the elevation of the lowest floor used for rating, or the floodproofed elevation, and the base flood elevation (BFE), or base flood depth, as appropriate. Round to nearest higher elevation difference in whole feet using .5 as the midpoint

NOTE: The depth shown on the Flood Insurance Rate Map (FIRM) for Zone AO that indicates the depth of water above the highest adjacent grade resulting from a flood that has a 1% chance of equaling or exceeding that level in any given year. The elevation of surface water resulting from a flood that has a 1% chance of equaling or exceeding that level in any given year. The BFE is shown on the FloodInsurance Rate Map (FIRM) for Zones AE, AH, A1-A30, AR, AR/A, AR/AE, AR/A1-A30, AR/AH, AR/A0, V1-V30 andVE.
The value of 9999.0 indicates the field is not reported and/or used for this policy
